admin.title: Question bank
admin.description: Papers decide who gets which rating, so this is instructors and above — each scoped to the divisions they instruct in.

admin.noDivision: You do not instruct in any division, so there is no bank for you to edit.
admin.globalScope: You may edit every division's bank.

admin.grantCeilingNone: Papers you write may not grant a rating.

papers.title: Papers
papers.name: Name
papers.deleteConfirm: Delete “{title}” and every question on it? Members' recorded results are kept.
papers.shortBank: The bank holds only {count} questions — fewer than the draw
papers.deleteQuestions: Its {count} questions go with it. Members' recorded results are kept.

paper.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Candidates sit it at /sit/<address>.
paper.divisionHelp: Decides who may edit this paper: that division's instructors, plus SUP/ADM.
paper.name: Name
paper.drawHelp: 0 asks every enabled question in the bank.
paper.eligibleHelp: Leave empty to let any member sit it.
paper.promoteHelp: An exam may not grant SUP or ADM.
paper.scopeHelp: Which track it appears under in the exam centre.
paper.descriptionHelp: Optional. Shown on the card in the exam centre.
paper.passMarkHelp: Reaching this percentage is a pass.
paper.publishHelp: Off means draft: visible to people who can manage the bank, and to nobody else.

questions.title: Questions
questions.empty: This paper has no questions yet
questions.explanationHelp: Optional. Never served with the paper.
questions.markOne: Mark exactly one option as correct.
questions.needOptions: A question needs at least two options.
questions.enabledHelp: A disabled question is never drawn, but papers already in progress still count it.
questions.noMatchesHint: Try another word, or clear the filters.
questions.warnShortBank: The draw asks for {draw} but only {count} questions are enabled — a sitting will be {count} questions long.
questions.warnAllDisabled: Every question is disabled, so this exam cannot be sat.
questions.promptPlaceholder: Write the question here; line breaks are fine
questions.editWarning: This question is live. Saving gives its options new ids, so anyone who has already drawn it will have that question marked wrong — that applies even to a topic or explanation change. To only flip it on or off, use the switch in the list; that one leaves the options alone.
questions.previewHint: Options are reshuffled on every sitting; this is just an illustration.
questions.multipleHelp: Candidates see checkboxes. Partial credit for a partial answer, wrong ticks subtract, ticking everything scores nothing.
questions.markSome: Mark at least one option correct, and leave at least one wrong.
questions.markNotAll: Not every option may be correct — ticking them all would score full marks.
questions.imageHelp: Optional. Uploaded straight away; saving the question is what puts it to use.
questions.imageFailed: The image could not be uploaded.

errors.wrong_region: You may only file papers under a division you instruct in.
errors.grant_too_high: An exam may not grant your own rating or above.
errors.forbidden: You do not instruct in any division.
errors.gone: That question is gone — somebody may have deleted it.
